## 0.2.236

owes: the Users page is a row list with a page per person (`/settings/users/{id}`) and a new-user page (`/settings/users/new`), and the admin form posts now redirect to the person page (create errors to the new-user page); Delete and *Reset two-factor* sit behind a confirmation; saving Administration stores `admin` alone, so an account already stored with extra role tokens beside `admin` keeps them until its next save from the page (no migration), and after unticking Administration the narrower roles must be ticked again; `GET /api/v1/users` gains `secondFactor` per row (a consumer that rejects unknown fields must accept it); rollback safe.

owes: none — the weather sensor page is rebuilt (a *Use for* button per found sensor that saves with the city's coordinates and runs Check, a data-width two-column layout, a status card, abbreviated discovery keys and more unit and template spellings read, a fixed reason on each manual result); the stored sensor record and the `/api/v1` sensors answer are unchanged, no migration, rollback safe.

owes: the sign-in page's two-factor code field moves into a closed *I have a two-factor code* fold after the Sign in button (a new `login.codeSummary` catalogue key in five locales); it stays in the same form, so `POST /login` keeps its fields (`name`, `password`, `code`), its one request and its uniform 401; no route, record or wire change, no migration, rollback safe.

owes: the notes editor's title and body saves now answer only the status line (a conflict still answers the whole editor, with `HX-Retarget: #notes-editor-fields`), and the editor is laid out as one stack with a footer row (*More* and *Done*); every route, form field and `/api/v1` answer is unchanged, no migration, rollback safe.

owes: the stocks instrument page is rebuilt (header band, a 200 px price chart, an *Alerts* label, the footer last) and the quote footer sentence on that page and on the board cards changes from *Updated … · <host> · CHART* to *Updated … · source <host>* (a new `stocks.status.source` catalogue key in five locales; the fetch role is no longer shown, and stays in the record and `/api/v1`); no route, record or wire change, no migration, rollback safe.

owes: the sign-in form gains `id="login"` and `name="login"`, and the change-password form and the first-run set-password form each carry a hidden, read-only `username` input holding the account's name (the first-run field also gains an `id` and a label); form markup only, the server reads no `username`, no key, route or field name changes, no migration, rollback safe.

owes: none — the *Pair a device* page (and the setup wizard's device step) gains the pairing link as an anchor and a closed *Show the link* fold under the QR, with three new catalogue keys in five locales; no route, record, CSP or wire change, no migration, rollback safe.
